title: Reflexive Pronoun
theory:
 Reflexive Pronoun is used when the subject and the object of a sentence refer to the
 same person or thing.

 Subject Reflexive Pronoun
 I Myself
 We Ourselves
 He Himself
 She Herself
 They Themselves
 It Itself
 One Oneself
 You Yourself/ Yourselves
 Verbs that take reflexive Pronoun - avail, enjoy, absent, adapt, pride, apply, adjust, reconcile,
 acquit, devote, behave, revenge, exert.
 Verbs that do not take reflexive Pronoun - bath, qualify, turn, stop, keep, move, hide, rest,
 feel, sleep, shave, wash.
 Point to remember
